steps.title: Accept the composition table
steps.question: Why does Gate allow Table 1?
steps.look: Table 1 reports dismantled phone fractions. Gate accepts it as target composition based on the caption, reference and headers.
steps.boundary: Gate classifies the table; it does not extract values or verify every resulting fact.

steps.title: Skip economic value, not composition
steps.question: Why is Table 4 excluded?
steps.look: Table 4 reports prices and potential revenue. Gate skips it as economic value, unlike Table 1's measured composition.
steps.boundary: This successful trace is not a complete accuracy evaluation. Other guides show revision and failure cases.

steps.title: Trace the 45.4 cell
steps.question: Where does the battery fraction come from?
steps.look: The highlighted 45.4 cell belongs to Nokia 5110 (1998), Batteries (wt%). The table-extracted relation retains its coordinates and raw value.
steps.boundary: This is battery mass fraction, not metal recovery. The raw unit label is weight_percent.

steps.title: Attach scope: identify the phone sample
steps.question: A general phone category or a specific model?
steps.look: After document merge and revision, Scope adds source context. Scope identifies Nokia 5110 (1998). The paragraph describes 20 collected phone types; Table 1 supplies the model name.
steps.boundary: Read paragraph and table together. Model-level evidence does not identify an individual device by serial number. Scope is post-merge provenance, not an upstream extraction input.

steps.title: Check the final relation
steps.question: Did the value and source survive?
steps.look: Nokia 5110 (1998) → CONTAINS → battery keeps 45.4 wt.% and the same source cell.
steps.boundary: Matching anchors connect separate archives; they do not prove a continuous historical run.

steps.title: Keep Cu on the right component
steps.question: Does 62.50% Cu describe the whole phone?
steps.look: The 62.50 cell describes Cu in the model's electronic parts. The final relation keeps that Component as its subject.
steps.boundary: This is not whole-phone Cu content. No fractions are multiplied or new measurements inferred.

steps.title: Keep measurements with the study sample
steps.question: Who owns the reported 45.4 wt.%?
steps.look: With fusion links hidden, the 45.4 wt.% battery fraction stays on the paper's Nokia 5110 (1998) → battery relation. Inspect its source observation before revealing catalog alignment.
steps.boundary: This is the study sample's measurement, not a catalog specification. Hiding links is a display toggle, not an ablation or rerun.

steps.title: Align the model, not the measurements
steps.question: What is connected, and what stays separate?
steps.look: Observed for product model connects two distinct nodes: the paper sample and catalog Nokia 5110. Recorded evidence is a shared model designation and Scope label match. Both nodes also list 1998.
steps.boundary: The same model does not mean the same physical phone. The paper's 45.4 wt.% is not copied to the catalog or averaged with other observations.
